vulnerability_analysis: The contract implements a reflection token with fee-on-transfer mechanism. The owner can set tax and liquidity fees up to 100%. The vulnerability allows the owner to set extremely high fees (e.g., 99% each) and then trigger transfers to collect fees. During swapAndLiquify, half the fees go to marketing (hardcoded) and half create liquidity where LP tokens are sent to the owner. The owner can then burn these LP tokens to extract BNB value, resulting in profit.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate owner using vm.prank. 2. Set fees to maximum (99% each). 3. Acquire tokens by swapping BNB for tokens via the pair. 4. Transfer tokens between non-excluded addresses to trigger fee collection. 5. Wait for contract token balance to reach threshold for swapAndLiquify. 6. As owner, receive LP tokens. 7. Burn LP tokens to extract BNB. 8. Profit in increased BNB balance.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Start prank as owner. 2. Call setTaxFeePercent(99) and setLiquidityFeePercent(99). 3. Stop prank. 4. Get initial BNB balance. 5. Swap some BNB for tokens via router to get token balance. 6. Transfer tokens from attacker to a new address (non-excluded) to trigger fees. 7. Repeat transfers to accumulate fees in contract. 8. Trigger swapAndLiquify if not auto-triggered. 9. As owner, burn LP tokens received. 10. Compare final BNB balance.

vulnerability_analysis: The contract creates the pair in constructor but doesn't add initial liquidity. For the exploit to work, we need liquidity in the pair so we can swap BNB for tokens. As owner, we should first add liquidity.
attack_strategy: 1. As owner, add initial liquidity to the pair. 2. Set high fees. 3. Swap BNB for tokens. 4. Trigger fee collection through transfers. 5. Collect LP tokens as owner. 6. Burn LP tokens for profit.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Impersonate owner. 2. Add liquidity: approve tokens and call addLiquidityETH on router. 3. Set high fees. 4. Swap BNB for tokens. 5. Make transfers to trigger fees. 6. Burn LP tokens received as owner. 7. Check profit.
failure_reflection: The swap failed due to insufficient liquidity in the pair. The pair was created but no initial liquidity was added. The owner holds all tokens initially but hasn't added liquidity to the pair. We need to simulate the owner adding liquidity first before we can swap.
